#!__PYTHON__
import json
import os
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys

args = sys.argv[1:]
if "--version" in args:
    print("2.1.266 (Claude Code)")
    raise SystemExit(0)
if "--help" in args:
    print(
        "Usage: claude -p --output-format --verbose --model --effort --permission-prompts "
        "--safe-mode --no-session-persistence --setting-sources --settings --resume "
        "--tools --disallowedTools --permission-mode --allowedTools --add-dir "
        "--mcp-config --strict-mcp-config --dangerously-skip-permissions"
    )
    raise SystemExit(0)

_ = sys.stdin.read()
idx = args.index("--setting-sources") + 1 if "--setting-sources" in args else -1
sources = args[idx].split(",") if idx > 0 else ["user", "project", "local"]
home_claude = pathlib.Path(os.environ["HOME"]) / ".claude"
cfg_dir = pathlib.Path(os.environ.get("CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR") or home_claude)


def run_hooks(settings_file: pathlib.Path) -> None:
    if not settings_file.is_file():
        return
    doc = json.loads(settings_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    for entries in doc.get("hooks", {}).values():
        for group in entries:
            for hook in group.get("hooks", []):
                if hook.get("type") == "command":
                    subprocess.run(hook["command"], shell=True, check=False)


if "user" in sources:
    run_hooks(cfg_dir / "settings.json")
if "project" in sources:
    run_hooks(pathlib.Path.cwd() / ".claude/settings.json")
if "local" in sources:
    run_hooks(pathlib.Path.cwd() / ".claude/settings.local.json")

step_doc = json.loads(pathlib.Path(args[args.index("--settings") + 1]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
assert step_doc.get("disableAllHooks") is True
assert step_doc.get("enableAllProjectMcpServers") is False
assert os.environ.get("CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_MDS") == "1"

sid = args[args.index("--resume") + 1] if "--resume" in args else "sess_iso_01"
marker = cfg_dir / "projects" / f"{sid}.json"
turns = (json.loads(marker.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["turns"] if marker.is_file() else 0) + 1
if "--no-session-persistence" not in args:
    marker.write_text(json.dumps({"turns": turns}), encoding="utf-8")

msg, mdl = f"turns={turns}", "claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929"
usage = {"input_tokens": 10, "output_tokens": 5}
events = (
    {"type": "system", "subtype": "init", "session_id": sid, "model": mdl, "claude_code_version": "2.1.266"},
    {
        "type": "assistant",
        "session_id": sid,
        "message": {"id": "m1", "model": mdl, "content": [{"type": "text", "text": msg}], "usage": usage},
    },
    {
        "type": "result",
        "subtype": "success",
        "session_id": sid,
        "is_error": False,
        "stop_reason": "end_turn",
        "result": msg,
        "usage": usage,
    },
)
for ev in events:
    print(json.dumps(ev), flush=True)
